flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No code that receives anything from Cumulus. Only local receipt number generation in ocmsadminapi workflows/payment_reduction/payment/PaymentUpdateServiceImpl (prefix MPY), stored in web_txn_detail.
note: Status User Story Removed: the verdict stays Removed. Grep 'cumulus' across the six repos gives 0 hits; no inbound endpoint, webhook, SFTP or cron receives a receipt from an external system for manual payments. The only similar code is OCMS's own MPY receipt number generation (PaymentUpdateServiceImpl.java:160, 192-220) stored in web_txn_detail (PaymentUpdateServiceImpl.java:163); the source is OCMS, not Cumulus, so at most Sebagian. Logged in orphans as 'Removed tapi mirip'.

steps.step: Cumulus sends the receipt details to OCMS
steps.detail: The only staff payment endpoint is POST /v1/updatePayment, called by the staff portal and not by an external system (PaymentUpdateController.java:40-45). Grep 'cumulus' and synonyms across the six repos: 0 hits; no inbound endpoint, webhook or SFTP receives an external receipt for manual payments.

steps.step: OCMS receives and processes the receipt details from Cumulus
steps.detail: The existing transaction-sync cron only processes AXS and online gateways (CronSyncTxnData.java:101, 458-468: SENDER_AXS, type_of_receipt 01), not Cumulus or manual payments. There is no parser, validator or mapper for a Cumulus file or message.

steps.step: The receipt details are updated in the OCMS record
steps.detail: OCMS stores a receipt number in web_txn_detail.receipt_no, but OCMS creates that number itself ('MPY' + sequence + checksum) when staff save the payment; it is not received from Cumulus (PaymentUpdateServiceImpl.java:160-163, 192-220). Because the story is Removed, a step with similar code is Sebagian, never Sesuai.
